Riemannian Geometry

Information

Textbook Used:Hongxi Wu et al. — An Introduction to Riemannian GeometryManfredo P. do Carmo — Riemannian Geometry

Participants:

LingYu Yu, Hanzhen Bao, Jingcao Wu (Sufe Mentor), Hongzhi Liu (Sufe Mentor)

History & Progress

Sep 25, 2026, Y-B, Differential Topology 1

  • Smooth Manifolds; Tangent Spaces and Tangent Maps; Inverse Function and Constant Rank Theorems; Regular Values and Sard’s Theorem; Submanifolds; Tubular Neighborhoods; Cup Product and Intersection; Transversality.

  • Notes (PDF)
Oct 9, 2026, Y-B, Differential Topology 2

  • Vector fields; Time-dependent vector fields and isotopies; Moser’s trick; Flows; Introduction to Morse theory; Handle decomposition; Morse homology; Stable and unstable manifolds; Morse–Smale condition and moduli space; Poincaré duality; Lie derivative; Chern–Weil theory; Smooth structures on spheres and the Poincaré conjecture.

  • Notes (PDF)
Oct 14, 2026, Y-B, Differential Topology 3

  • Tensors; Wedge product; Differential forms and pullback; Exterior derivative; de Rham cohomology; Lie derivative; Connections; Hopf invariant; Volume-preserving flows; Degree of a map and local orientation; Orientation; Integration; Counting.

  • Notes (PDF)
Oct 19, 2026, Y-B, Riemannian Geometry 1

  • Course outline; Riemannian metrics; Connections and the Levi–Civita connection; Geodesics; Exponential map; Curvature and Jacobi fields; Curvature contractions; Curvature and topology; Complex manifolds and almost complex structures; Complexified tangent and cotangent bundles; Differential forms and Dolbeault cohomology; Hermitian and Kähler metrics; Examples and the canonical bundle; Hodge theory and Kodaira theorems.

  • Notes (PDF)
Oct 27, 2026, Y-B, Riemannian Geometry 2

  • Levi–Civita connection and Riemann curvature; Ricci, scalar and sectional curvature; Curvature in dimension three and Einstein manifolds; Covariant derivatives of tensors; Gradient; Commutation of covariant derivatives; Second Bianchi identity; An Einstein condition; Hessian and Laplacian; Bochner formula for functions; The Laplacian on a closed manifold; The first eigenvalue estimate; Divergence of a vector field; Isometry group and Killing vector fields; Bochner formula for Killing fields; Consequences for the isometry group; Harmonic one-forms and Ricci solitons.

  • Notes (PDF)
Nov 2, 2026, B, Supplement 1

  • Connections and their arguments; Existence of connections; The Levi–Civita connection; Koszul formula and orthonormal frames; Induced metrics and connections; Covariant derivatives along curves; Parallel fields and parallel transport; Metric compatibility and parallel transport.

  • Notes (PDF)
Nov 5, 2026, B, Supplement 2

  • Covariant derivatives along curves; Geodesics; Exponential map; Riemann curvature tensor; Jacobi fields; The do Carmo convention and curvature identities; Curvature components; Sectional curvature; Constant sectional curvature; Ricci and scalar curvature; Coordinate expressions and traces.

  • Notes (PDF)
